subject: Re: Cross-Departmental Project Update
body: Hi Jane, I've attached the latest figures and projections for the cross-departmental project. Could you provide the technical specs from IT to ensure we're aligned? Thanks, Alex

subject: Classified: Secure System Update Required
body: Jane, As your manager, I need you to address the vulnerabilities within our secure systems that require immediate attention. Please review the attached document outlining the steps needed for the system update. This is a top-priority issue, and we need the IT department to implement these changes without delay. Ensure all communications regarding this matter are encrypted and kept confidential. Regards, Mr. Thompson
